modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the team complies with organisation’s health, safety, security policies and procedures
identify the risks and hazards associated with work activities, their causes and prevention as per organisation's policy
encourage team to report any identified breaches in health, safety, and security policies and procedures to the designated person

modules.module_title: Ensure work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure work area is kept clean and tidy
identify individual work requirements and provide necessary instructions to the team
ensure the team works as per the assigned and agreed requirements
identify work which fails the requirements, specified quality standards and ensure timely corrective action is taken
implement ways and guide the team to manage time, resources and cost effectively
train the team on skill level advancement to develop expertise in their work
ensure that the team understands accountability for timely completion of tasks
analyse and validate the problem accurately and communicate different possible solutions to the problem
identify ways to optimize usage of electricity/other source of energy and material including water in various tasks/activities/processes
ensure that the team uses resources in a responsible manner
ensure that the team periodically checks for spills/leakages around the work area and take corrective actions or escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
supervise team to carry out routine cleaning of tools, machine and equipment
ensure that the team periodically checks if the equipment/machines are maintained and functioning normally before commencing work and take corrective action wherever required
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste generated
ensure the team segregates waste into different categories
ensure proper disposal of non-recyclable waste
ensure recyclable and reusable material is deposited at identified location
ensure the team follows processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste

modules.module_title: Ensure a healthy and hygienic workplace

pcs.pc_description: ensure workplace, equipment, restrooms etc. are sanitized regularly
promote awareness about hygiene and sanitation regulations
check availability of running water, hand wash and alcohol-based sanitizers at workplace
support employees to cope with stress, anxiety etc.
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately

modules.module_title: Inspect the vehicle and identify/validate faults

pcs.pc_description: review the job card, obtain required information from customer/service advisor to assess service and repair requirements
identify the auto components related to the various aggregates in the vehicle
check the functioning of vehicle systems such as lighting system, air conditioning system etc.
conduct test drive to check vehicle performance and identify/validate the faults
conduct visual inspection of the vehicle to identify defects in HV (High Voltage) components
assess mechanical components/aggregates such as brake pad/shoe, wheel cylinder, mountings, bushes, control arms etc. of the vehicle for any external impact/bend/leak/incorrect level/wear & tear
determine the precise location of faults in vehicle systems
ensure no HV activity is being conducted around workstation prior to commencement of work
prepare the vehicle according to nature of job to be performed: general and mechanical job on the vehicle/electrical work in non-live state/troubleshoot and replace parts in live state of HV system
mark the vehicle and safeguard the working area during electrical work
collect workshop tools/measuring device/equipment required for fault diagnosis in vehicle systems and check their condition/calibration
report the malfunctions if any, in the tools/equipment to the person concerned for rectification

modules.module_title: Perform tests to identify the root cause of fault

pcs.pc_description: take precautions to avoid damage to the vehicle and its components during diagnosis or troubleshooting the faults

use checklists and OEM Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to understand if the fault is because of improper charging, loose/poor contacts of pins in wiring harness connectors and their connection, improper driving style etc.

select and apply the appropriate device/equipment to make inspection and diagnose deficiencies/faults in various systems such as Body management systems, Braking and stability control systems, Drive line systems, Battery management system, Telematics system, etc.
use manufacturer's and component supplier’s specifications to identify duplicate or defective component/parts which cannot be detected during visual inspection
follow SOP set out for troubleshooting and perform tests using various mechanical, electrical/electronic measuring devices/tester/diagnostic tools/software to identify/isolate a fault

perform diagnostic task on the HV system as per following stages: general and mechanical tasks on the vehicle which do not require isolation of the HV systems, electrical work in non-live state of the HV systems, troubleshoot and replace parts in live state of the HV system
diagnose indirect faults if any, in vehicle's mechanical, electrical and electronic systems as per OEM SOP
report the malfunctions in the vehicle where solution is not available or in case of new premature failures, to the concerned person along with preliminary diagnostic details
dismantle and reassemble aggregates of a vehicle for fault diagnosis

modules.module_title: Conclude the repair solution for the fault

pcs.pc_description: maintain the documentation related to inspections and troubleshooting performed on the vehicle
interpret results as required
compare results of diagnostic inspections/tests with vehicle specifications and regulatory requirements
validate the options for repair or replacement
prepare final proposal regarding repair or replacement requirements with justification

modules.module_title: Prepare to carry out routine service and repairs

pcs.pc_description: review the job card, obtain sufficient information from customer/service advisor to assess service and repair needs of the vehicle
identify the auto components related to the various aggregates in the vehicle
collect workshop tools/measuring devices/equipment required for the job and check their condition/calibration
report the malfunctions if any, in the tools/equipment to the person concerned for rectification
ensure no HV (High Voltage) activity is being conducted around workstation prior to commencement of work
prepare the vehicle according to nature of job to be performed: general and mechanical job on the vehicle/electrical work in non-live state/troubleshoot and replace parts in live state of HV system
mark the vehicle and safeguard the working area during electrical work
conduct visual inspection of the vehicle to identify defects in HV components
assess mechanical components/aggregates such as brake pad/shoe, wheel cylinder, mountings, bushes, control arms etc. of the vehicle for any external impact/bend/leak/incorrect level/wear & tear
prepare final proposal regarding repair or replacement requirements with justification
report the malfunctions/repairs in the vehicle beyond own scope to the concerned person
take precautions to avoid damage to the vehicle and its components while working on various aggregates

perform task on the HV system as per following stages: general and mechanical tasks on the vehicle which do not require isolation of the HV systems, mechanical work in non live state of the HV systems and replace parts in live state of the HV system
use workshop tools/measuring devices/equipment required for the job as per OEM Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
remove parts relevant to various mechanical aggregates and place them securely as specified by OEM
dismantle mechanical aggregates, if required and report additional repair requirement
clean and condition dismantled components, including mechanical and electrical aggregates, prior to assembly
perform repair/replacement/calibration/overhauling of mechanical system/aggregate such as drive line, running systems, etc. including power assisted braking & steering systems
maintain the documentation related to inspection, servicing and repair of the vehicle
check the performance of vehicle/aggregate post repair and report to supervisor/service advisor if further inspection is required by another specialist
ensure completeness of tasks assigned before releasing the vehicle for the next procedure
dispose off materials such as waste oil, scrap of failed parts/aggregates, as per organisation’s policies
ensure all tools, auxiliary material and other equipment must be removed from the work site
perform scheduled checks, calibration and timely repairs for workshop tools, equipment and workstations
